Without a pre-existing structure, you may need to be more intentional and reflective about what truly matters to you. However, without such a framework, you may need to rely more on your own values, goals, and personal reflections to guide your decisions. This can be both a challenge and an opportunity. To figure out what's worth your time, you may need to engage in more self-reflection and exploration. By taking the time to reflect on these questions and explore your own values and priorities, you can create a personalized framework for deciding what's worth your time and energy. Ultimately, not having a traditional religious or cultural framework can be a liberating experience, allowing you to create your own path and priorities.
